name: Clean Matrix 3x3
question: Clean replication of exp-05/11 -- does a 3x3 matrix produce +9 clones with Pages disabled?

results.notes: Clean replicate of exp-05 with Pages disabled. Exp-11 was contaminated by Pages build producing +1 clone/day. This should show 9 clones if Pages was the sole contaminant.
